items.description: Map repository architecture, module responsibilities, and data flow
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/phase_1/repo_architecture.md` documenting `.archivara/concept_evolve.py`, `.archivara/semantic_scholar.py`, `.opencode/tools/*.ts`, `.opencode/agents/*.md`, and how commands populate `results/concept_evolve/*` and downstream analysis artifacts.

items.description: Formalize the mathematical target and success definition for tighter lower bounds on Bu
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/phase_1/problem_spec.md` containing formal definitions of `B_f` and `B_u`, the baseline lower bound `0.5708858`, at least 3 explicit target milestones above baseline (e.g., +1e-4, +5e-4, +1e-3), and proof-validity requirements for claiming improvement.

items.description: Conduct broad web literature and code search for state-of-the-art methods
items.acceptance_criteria: Run web searches covering univalent Bloch/Landau constants, extremal schlicht-function methods, Loewner-chain optimization, and rigorous numerics; save `results/phase_1/literature_scan.json` with at least 20 unique sources including at least 10 papers and 3 code repositories.

items.description: Create and maintain canonical bibliography in repo root
items.acceptance_criteria: Create/update `sources.bib` in repo root with valid BibTeX entries for all consulted sources, including Skinner (2009), Yanagihara (1995), and Bhowmik-Sen (2023), and include at least 10 relevant papers total.

items.description: Delegate literature exploration and synthesis to subagents
items.acceptance_criteria: Execute at least one exploration handoff and one synthesis handoff (e.g., `literature-graph-miner` then writer/reviewer synthesis); save outputs to `results/phase_1/subagent_literature_synthesis.md` with at least 5 prioritized research gaps linked to citations in `sources.bib`.

items.description: Specify reproducible baseline pipeline from existing tooling
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/phase_2/baseline_pipeline.md` with command-level workflow using semantic scholar and concept evolve tools (`search`, `graph`, `evolve`, `walk`, `probe`), explicit input/output contracts, and rerun instructions for a clean workspace.

items.description: Define quantitative metrics and stopping criteria
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/phase_2/metrics_schema.json` with at least 8 metrics including `best_lower_bound`, `rigorous_certificate_pass`, `numerical_error_bound`, `runtime_seconds`, and `reproducibility_delta`; include explicit pass/fail thresholds.

items.description: Reproduce published baseline bounds as calibration checkpoints
items.acceptance_criteria: Produce `results/phase_2/baseline_reproduction.md` re-deriving or computationally validating the known `B_u > 0.5708858` benchmark and the weaker `L <= B_u` chain bound, with equation references and a numeric consistency check to within `1e-7` where applicable.

items.description: Generate initial concept-tree workspace and prioritize high-value branches
items.acceptance_criteria: Run concept-tree generation so that `results/concept_evolve/tree/index.json`, `results/concept_evolve/tree/adjacency.json`, and `results/concept_evolve/tree/walk_paths.json` exist, with at least 14 concept folders and a ranked shortlist of top 5 candidate branches in `results/phase_2/concept_branch_priorities.md`.

items.description: Delegate baseline risk audit to subagents
items.acceptance_criteria: Use one exploration delegation and one synthesis delegation to audit baseline assumptions; store `results/phase_2/subagent_baseline_audit.md` with at least 8 concrete risks, each with severity and mitigation owner.

items.description: Design Loewner-control extremal framework for improving Bu lower bounds
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/phase_3/approach_loewner_control.md` with formal control variables, admissibility constraints for univalent maps, optimization objective tied to largest schlicht disk radius, and comparison against at least 3 prior works from `sources.bib`.

items.description: Design coefficient-body and area-theorem constrained optimization approach
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/phase_3/approach_coefficient_relaxation.md` specifying truncation order, constraint set (e.g., de Branges/area-type inequalities), solver strategy, and a plan to extract rigorous certificates from numerical optima.

items.description: Design conformal-map search with interval-certified validation
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/phase_3/approach_interval_certified_extremals.md` including candidate function parameterization, interval arithmetic validation protocol, and required certificate artifacts to prevent false improvements.

items.description: Select cross-domain research bridges by traversing concept tree
items.acceptance_criteria: Analyze `results/concept_evolve/tree/walk_paths.json` and produce `results/phase_3/bridge_selection.md` with at least 3 multi-step bridge chains, each mapped to one experiment module and one falsifiable hypothesis.

items.description: Delegate novelty exploration and synthesis for method portfolio selection
items.acceptance_criteria: Perform at least 2 exploration delegations plus 1 synthesis delegation; produce `results/phase_3/subagent_novelty_synthesis.md` ranking at least 4 candidate methods on novelty, feasibility, rigor, and expected bound gain.

items.description: Define experiment registry and dependency-aware execution plan
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/phase_4/experiment_registry.json` listing at least 3 method families, required inputs from phase 3 artifacts, parameter grids, compute budgets, and expected outputs.

items.description: Run systematic experiments and ablations across selected concept branches
items.acceptance_criteria: Execute at least 30 runs spanning at least 3 concept-tree branches from `results/concept_evolve/tree/`; store run metadata and outcomes in `results/phase_4/runs/` plus consolidated table `results/phase_4/ablation_table.csv`.

items.description: Produce rigorous verification artifacts for candidate improvements
items.acceptance_criteria: For every candidate lower bound improvement above 0.5708858, generate a verification bundle in `results/phase_4/certificates/` containing assumptions, error bounds, and an independent recomputation check; no unchecked claim may appear in summary tables.

items.description: Benchmark experimental outcomes against prior literature
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/phase_4/literature_comparison.md` comparing best observed bounds to at least 5 prior references from `sources.bib` (including Skinner 2009), with absolute/relative improvement columns and discussion of rigor differences.

items.description: Delegate independent replication and synthesis review
items.acceptance_criteria: Use one exploration delegation to rerun a representative experiment subset and one synthesis delegation to analyze discrepancies; save `results/phase_4/subagent_replication_review.md` demonstrating reproducibility delta <= 1e-4 on at least 5 runs.

items.description: Consolidate final bound claim with evidence traceability
items.acceptance_criteria: Write `results/phase_5/final_bound_claim.md` with theorem-style statement, final best lower bound candidate, proof/certificate dependencies, and explicit trace links to phase 4 verification artifacts.

items.description: Perform sensitivity, robustness, and failure-mode analysis
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/phase_5/robustness_analysis.md` quantifying sensitivity to key parameters and assumptions, documenting at least 3 failure modes and their mitigation status.

items.description: Document modular dependency graph for the full research program
items.acceptance_criteria: Create `results/phase_5/research_dependency_graph.json` and `results/phase_5/research_dependency_graph.md` mapping all phase artifacts, explicit prerequisites, and concept-tree module links from `results/concept_evolve/tree/`.

items.description: Prepare manuscript-quality research narrative with citation compliance
items.acceptance_criteria: Draft `results/phase_5/manuscript_draft.md` that includes methodology, experiments, limitations, and comparison to prior work, with at least 10 in-text citations matching entries in `sources.bib`.

items.description: Delegate final peer-style review and synthesis sign-off
items.acceptance_criteria: Run one exploration delegation and one synthesis/review delegation to produce `results/phase_5/subagent_final_review.md` with a release checklist; all critical issues must be resolved or explicitly waived with rationale.
